QuestInfo.name: [7th Day of Memories] Memories of Thanksgiving
QuestInfo.0: #p9010010# has something to discuss with you.
QuestInfo.1: It's a little late, but #p9010010# wants a taste of Thanksgiving turkey. Collect 50 Roasted Turkeys and bring them to her.
QuestInfo.2: Will #p9010010# succeed in cooking a turkey of her own? Probably not.

0.0: Do you remember the turkey everyone had for Thanksgiving? I heard that it was super-duper delicious! But... I missed out... I was doing my nails! Even #p9000021# got some! Can you imagine how frustrating this is for me? Can you?!

yes.0: I'm glad you understand. Now, the problem is that monsters have gotten away with all the leftover turkey. Eliminate those selfish monsters and bring me 50 Roasted Turkeys. You must already know that you won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you, right?

no.0: Grr... No one understands how hard it is being me...
